mapper.sql: balance + CASE WHEN account_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN ROUND(balance * interest_rate * (GREATEST(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, start_date, maturity_date), 12), 1) + 1) / 24) ELSE ROUND(balance * interest_rate * GREATEST(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, start_date, maturity_date), 12), 1) / 12) END
mapper.select: SELECT id AS accountId, account_name AS accountName, maturity_date AS maturityDate, balance AS principalAmount, AS maturityAmount, interest_rate AS interestRate, DATEDIFF(maturity_date, CURDATE()) AS daysUntilMaturity FROM linked_bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_dormant = FALSE AND account_type IN ('SAVINGS', 'DEPOSIT') AND maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND interest_rate IS NOT NULL AND maturity_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY maturity_date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS accountId, account_name AS accountName, maturity_date AS maturityDate, balance AS principalAmount, AS maturityAmount, interest_rate AS interestRate, DATEDIFF(maturity_date, CURDATE()) AS daysUntilMaturity FROM linked_bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_dormant = FALSE AND account_type IN ('SAVINGS', 'DEPOSIT') AND maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND interest_rate IS NOT NULL AND maturity_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY maturity_date ASC

SELECT id AS accountId, account_name AS accountName, maturity_date AS maturityDate, balance AS principalAmount, AS maturityAmount, interest_rate AS interestRate, DATEDIFF(maturity_date, CURDATE()) AS daysUntilMaturity FROM linked_bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{accountId} AND is_dormant = FALSE AND account_type IN ('SAVINGS', 'DEPOSIT') AND maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND interest_rate IS NOT NULL AND maturity_date >= CURDATE() LIMIT 1

SELECT ds.stock_code AS stockCode, ds.stock_name AS stockName, ds.category, ds.market, ds.dividend_yield AS dividendYield, ds.tags, ex.ex_date AS exDividendDate,
COALESCE(pay.per_share, ex.ex_amount) AS perShareDividend, pay.pay_date AS payDate FROM dividend_stocks ds
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.stock_code, e.event_date AS ex_date, e.amount AS ex_amount FROM stock_events e JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MIN(event_date) AS md FROM stock_events WHERE event_type = 'DIVIDEND_EX' AND event_date >= CURDATE() GROUP BY stock_code ) m ON e.stock_code = m.stock_code AND e.event_date = m.md AND e.event_type = 'DIVIDEND_EX' ) ex ON ds.stock_code = ex.stock_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.stock_code, p.event_date AS pay_date, p.amount AS per_share FROM stock_events p JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MIN(event_date) AS md FROM stock_events WHERE event_type = 'DIVIDEND_PAY' AND event_date >= CURDATE() AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount > 0 GROUP BY stock_code ) m ON p.stock_code = m.stock_code AND p.event_date = m.md AND p.event_type = 'DIVIDEND_PAY' ) pay ON ds.stock_code = pay.stock_code WHERE ds.is_active = TRUE AND ds.dividend_yield > #{interestRatePct} ORDER BY ds.dividend_yield DESC LIMIT 10
